verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe webhooks that deliver real-time notifications when specific events occur, replacing polling, and the product lists transaction notifications. The OBWMS docs describe an API for subscribing to specific events, but use future tense ('will provide'), so fine-grained subscription management may not yet be available. missing for 10: documented registration/configuration of callback URLs and event catalog, confirmation that OBWMS event-subscription API is generally available, independent or hands-on corroboration.
